content.text:
Finding submitted.

**LOL-CAP — deviation (Section 15, p0105).**

- Section 15 is the only liability-limiting provision: mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, mutual "direct damages only" remedy, and a mutual carve-out for Sections 13 (IP) and 14 (confidentiality) — but **no monetary cap at all**, leaving Sparkling exposed to unlimited direct damages. That fails the fallback (mutual 12 months' fees cap).
- Redline (validated ok:true) inserts the preferred mutual cap — greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable by Sparkling and USD 1,000,000 — plus an uncapped "Excluded Claims" definition (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and confirms Sparkling's fee obligations are not "damages". The existing Sections 13/14 carve-out sentence is preserved, and a straight 12 months' fees cap is offered as fallback.
